title: VMware Aria Operations for Networks getNotifiedEvents Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of VMware Aria Operations for Networks. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getNotifiedEvents method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of a service account that has unrestricted root privileges.
